name: omni-guard-aocds
description: Omni Guard AOCDS: Rust agent (service) + React/Vite dashboard

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && uv sync --project backend/scan
scripts.scan: uv run --project backend/scan --directory backend/scan uvicorn server:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.build: cd backend && cargo build --release && npm --prefix ../frontend run build
scripts.train: uv run --project backend/scan --directory backend/scan python train_ai.py
scripts.build:scan: uv run --project backend/scan --with pyinstaller python backend/scan/build.py
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -n app,win -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev" "npm --prefix desktop run dev"
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:setup && npm run build:ui && npm run build:agent && npm run build:scan && npm --prefix desktop run dist
